NODEJS_VERSION.description: Version of Node.js demanded. Can be an alias or a specific numeric version number

NODEJS_CUSTOM_EXECUTABLE_PATH.description: Path to existing host node.exe executable. If provided, bypasses installing a new Node.js runtime.

NODEJS_USE_SYSTEM.description: Reuse existing host Node.js runtime located at NODEJS_CUSTOM_EXECUTABLE_PATH rather than installing bundled Node.js.

NODEJS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install NODEJS. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.
